def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    vts, vt = parameters[0], parameters[1]
    gain = parameters[2]
    threshold_volts = vts + vt
    
    ID = gain * (gate_voltage_abs - threshold_volts) * (drain_voltage_abs - threshold_volts)**2
    return np.log10(np.abs(ID) / 1.0)
